title: SHL game archive manifest
description: Archive-owned manifest.json. File and skipped-directory arrays are written in ordinal path order. Runtime validation additionally enforces portable path safety, case-insensitive uniqueness, and that no files lie beneath a skipped directory.

files.description: Managed source-relative file paths only; excludes README.md and manifest.json.

filePath.description: Slash-separated relative file path. Runtime validation rejects reserved names, invalid platform characters, and case collisions.

directoryPath.description: Source-relative directory path ending in /, or . for the source root.

url.description: Absolute HTTP(S) source-directory URL without credentials, query, or fragment. Runtime validation requires a trailing slash.
